calls.head: Unstoppable force vs. Immovable object
calls.body: The Lightning are near the top of the league for chance quality, but the Wild are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Lightning.
calls.call: The Lightning’s chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Wild.

calls.head: The Wild don’t own Vasilevskiy
calls.body: Vasilevskiy has been shaky against the Wild since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
calls.call: If Vasilevskiy starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .912 than to his .877 against the Wild.

surprises.head: Tampa Bay hardly hit anyone
surprises.body: Tampa Bay’s hit score in the close stretches of the game was 47, against their usual 96 (100 is league average, adjusted for the arena’s scorer). A team strays this far about once every 20 games.

story.head: Carlson has two goals as the Lightning edge the Wild
paras: Anthony Cirelli opened the scoring for the Lightning early in the first, and John Carlson scored his first goal for Tampa Bay 36 seconds later to make it 2-0. Quinn Hughes got the Wild on the board early in the second. Carlson struck again on the power play less than three minutes later to make it 3-1 for the Bolts, and that one stood up as the winner. Blake Coleman cut Tampa Bay’s lead to 3-2 on the power play midway through the second.

The chances were close to even, so this one could have gone either way. Dennis Hildeby made 34 saves for the Lightning, and Jesper Wallstedt stopped 32 of 35 at the other end. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Jared Spurgeon, even in a loss, by our Swing measure. The Lightning moved to 3-1-0 and climbed to second in the Atlantic, while the Wild dropped to 2-1-1, slipping to fourth in the Central.

items.text: Three straight wins for the Lightning.
Nikita Kucherov extended his point streak against Minnesota to seven games.
